{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
trial_df = pd.read_csv('data/trial.csv')

# Check for sentinel values in biomarker_baseline
sentinel_baseline = trial_df[trial_df['biomarker_baseline'] == -999.0]

# Check if sentinel values are only in a certain group
sentinel_by_sex = sentinel_baseline.groupby('sex').size()
sentinel_by_arm = sentinel_baseline.groupby('arm').size()
sentinel_by_site = sentinel_baseline.groupby('site').size()

# Check response rates by sex and arm
response_by_sex_arm = pd.crosstab(trial_df['sex'], trial_df['arm'], values=trial_df['responded'], aggfunc='mean', margins=True)

# Check distribution of severity by sex
severity_by_sex = pd.crosstab(trial_df['sex'], trial_df['severity'])

sentinel_baseline.shape, sentinel_by_sex, sentinel_by_arm, sentinel_by_site, response_by_sex_arm, severity_by_sex"}
